title: Display
description: How the DIN Meter's screen looks.

keys.name: night_bright
keys.title: Night brightness
keys.description: Backlight while Signal K reports environment.mode night (signalk-espos-manager publishes it from the sun at the boat's position). 0 keeps the day brightness at night.

keys.name: dark_enabled
keys.title: Dark mode
keys.description: Allow dark mode: a long press on the knob turns it on and off. In dark mode the screen goes dark after the time below; a turn or press wakes it. It ends by itself when Signal K's environment.mode turns to day.
